title: TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to a lease with Huntleigh USA Corporation for cargo facilities located at…
text:
[Council File 26-1582; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to a lease with Huntleigh USA Corporation for cargo facilities located at 5600 West Century Boulevard, Suite 223, at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the Board of Airport Commissioners' (Board) adoption of staff's determination that the requested action is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article III, Class 1(18)(c) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE the one-year Lease, with a one-year extension option, with Huntleigh USA Corporation, and associated building rental rate, for premises located at 5600 West Century Boulevard, Suite 223, at LAX.
3. CONCUR with the Board's action on August 27, 2026, by Resolution No. 28428, authorizing the Chief Executive Officer, Los Angeles World Airports, or designee, to execute the Lease with Huntleigh USA Corporation.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The proposed lease will generate approximately $12,470 in revenue during the initial lease year. Total revenue over the potential two-year term is estimated at approximately $24,940, excluding any rental rate adjustments that may occur in accordance with the terms and conditions of the lease.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 28, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - NOVEMBER 20, 2026
